A.name: Azarel
A.line: the Korahite (1CH 12:6), chosen eleventh by lot (1CH 25:18)
A.notes: Korahites, eleventh chosen of the singers (1CH 25:18)
family: descendant-of korah-3 (Korah, son of Izhar (EXO 6:21) who rebelled against G-d and Moses ()

B.name: Azarel
B.line: Levite musician of Heman's family, head of the eleventh course

why: The Hebrew names one Azarel in the eleventh position, with his sons and brothers, matching B’s description as head of the eleventh course. The passage does not establish identity with the Korahite of 1 Chronicles 12:6, although A’s overlapping claim to this verse makes the supplied evidence inconclusive.
